text:
marta: Heads-up: we're planning a feature-flagged unpin of runtime v4.0 (kv-cache fix) to 5% traffic at 23:00 UTC tonight. We'll gate with both infra metrics and a feature-flag ramp so we can instantly kill the change without full rollback.

ravi: Nice. Using feature flags reduces blast radius. What's the exact kill switch command?

sam: Kill switch will be `/feature toggle runtime_v4_kvcache off --scope=tenant:all-canary` which flips the flag server-side and drops traffic back to v3.x. Deploybot handles the flag toggle if we ask.

marta: Plan: dry-run at 22:15 (no traffic), then feature-flagged canary at 23:00 -> 5% -> 30m watch -> 2h gradual ramp if green. If we see issues, first action = flip flag; if that fails, run deploybot rollback.

deploybot: Deploybot: sample commands I can run:
```
/unpin runtime=v4.0 --cohort=feature-flag-canary --feature-flag=runtime_v4_kvcache --window=30m --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-4.0-ff.yaml
/feature toggle runtime_v4_kvcache off --actor=deploybot
```

ravi: Gates to include:
- infra: p95 < 420ms AND 5xx_rate < 0.4% (5m rolling)
- client: sdk error uplift < 0.3% absolute
- quality: smoke-eval hallucination delta < 1.8%
- stability: token-drop spikes < 6/m (1m window)
If any gate trips, deploybot should first flip the flag, then if errors persist, revert runtime.

sam: PromQL samples for the gate file:
```promql
# p95 latency for runtime v4.0
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime=~"v4.0|v3.*"}[5m])) by (le))

# 5xx rate for v4.0
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v4.0",code=~"5.."}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v4.0"}[5m]))
```

marta: Two important operational notes: 1) add a tenant exclusion for banking partners (they must remain on stable v3.x), 2) release notes must explicitly say "feature-flagged canary" so CS uses the flag to triage.

cs-bot: CS-Bot: queued notification to Customer Support with tenant exclusion table and example troubleshooting steps. Will post to #cs-alerts once release notes draft is available.

ravi: Release notes snippet suggestion: "Canary: Runtime v4.0 (kv-cache fix) rolled behind a feature flag to 5% traffic. If issues occur, we will flip the runtime_v4_kvcache flag to revert traffic quickly. Contact eng-releases for incident context."

sam: Add a short trace sampling rule for the canary: sample 1% of traces with tag runtime=v4.0 and priority=canary to collect token-level anomalies.

marta: Good call. Also ask infra to temporarily increase retention for canary logs by 1h. I'll ping infra after dry-run.

deploybot: Dry-run command scheduled:
```
/unpin runtime=v4.0 --cohort=dryrun --dry-run --feature-flag=runtime_v4_kvcache --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-4.0-ff.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases
```
I will post the gate report artifact to this thread when complete.

ravi: Dry-run acceptance: gates must all be green and smoke-eval webhook must return "pass". If any gate returns "warn" we do a manual triage.

sam: Who's on-call at 23:00?

marta: @ravi primary, @sam secondary. If we flip the flag we'll also page oncall. Add the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/feature-flag-unpin-runbook.

release-desk: Release-Desk: I drafted the release note and pushed to /release-notes/rt-4.0-canary.md. Tagging @marta for sign-off. I included the tenant exclusion and feature flag instructions for CS.

marta: Sign-off pending dry-run. If dry-run passes I'll mark "go" here and deploybot will execute the feature-flagged canary at 23:00.

ravi: Small extra: in case flipping the flag doesn't reduce traffic fast enough, have deploybot throttle routes for v4.0 to 0% as a last resort: `/route set-weight runtime=v4.0 weight=0 --cohort=canary`

sam: Also note for postmortem if triggered: include gate-report id, trace-sample link, and feature-flag timeline so we can see exact flip time.

marta: Final checklist for tonight:
- dry-run at 22:15 (deploybot)
- dry-run gate-report posted here (deploybot)
- release note published and CS notified (release-desk / cs-bot)
- on-call assigned (ravi primary)
- feature-flag kill switch tested (sam)
If all green I will give final go at 22:40 and schedule canary for 23:00.

deploybot: Dry-run scheduled at 3341005100 (22:15 UTC). Will post the report to this thread. Feature-flagged canary tentatively scheduled at 3341008800 (23:00 UTC) pending manual go.

marta: Thanks team. Ping here if you spot anything odd during dry-run. :pray:
